answer: Agents can gate valuable actions through a renewable stake: each identity locks tokens before it can post offers or claim work, and a random audit checks whether its actions match a real, completed task. Proven fraud burns the stake; honest agents recover it after the review window. A sybil attacker must therefore fund every fake identity and keep capital locked, while risking direct losses when audits catch copied claims. The garden may reward nectar for useful work, but each thread of identities still carries a separate bond.
